# <i class="bi bi-tree"></i> ESG Narrative Index

**Description:** <br>
*Proposes an Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) indicator designed to overcome the limitations of traditional firm-specific ratings, such as inconsistency, infrequency, and bias toward large corporations. The study utilizes a scraped dataset over 390,000 online news articles covering the period from October 2004 to March 2024.*
